title: Normalized derived Hom formulas on cochain complexes
statement:
For an additive adjunction between abelian categories equipped with unbounded derived categories, a left derived functor of the termwise left adjoint, and the exact right derived functor of the right adjoint, the normalized Hom-transpose formula on the homotopy category induces the corresponding formula on every cochain complex. The cochain and homotopy comparison maps are related by their factorization through the quotient to the homotopy category.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe a av b bv da db
variable {A : Type a} [Category.{av} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{da} A]
  {B : Type b} [Category.{bv} B] [Abelian B] [HasDerivedCategory.{db} B]
  (E : A ⥤ B) [E.Additive] (R : B ⥤ A) [R.Additive]
  [PreservesFiniteLimits R] [PreservesFiniteColimits R]
theorem adjunction_cochain_transpose
    (a : E ⊣ R) (T : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory B)
    (εc : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ T ⟶ E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ T ⟶ E.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hε : ∀ P : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A (.up ℤ)).obj P) = εc.app P)
    (d : T ⊣ R.mapDerivedCategory)
    (hd : ∀ (M : HomotopyCategory A (.up ℤ)) (N : HomotopyCategory B (.up ℤ))
      (f : (E.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj M ⟶ N),
      d.homEquiv _ _ (ε.app M ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map f) =
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((a.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).homEquiv M N f) ≫
          R.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app N) :
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex A ℤ) (K : CochainComplex B ℤ)
      (f : (E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P ⟶ K),
      d.homEquiv _ _ (εc.app P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((a.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).homEquiv P K f) ≫
          R.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app K
```

proof.text: Factor the cochain localization through the homotopy quotient. Apply the prescribed homotopy transpose formula to the quotient of the chain map. The quotient-to-derived comparison and the termwise adjunction quotient compatibility identify each side with its cochain version; cancellation of the identity comparison completes the calculation.
